decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-c014b2928d8f]. It says workload identity support was added for "remote generic clusters" and links to PR #5452 and RFC-0010 for the details. It does not name a concrete subject (which CLI command, flag, API field or component). It also gives no default or enabling condition that would define who is exposed, and does not say what happens to an environment that takes no action. To fill these gaps we need the PR content, the RFC-0010 text or the matching CLI or API documentation.
